莫森帝国的某座边缘小城市
“呜哇哇哇哇！！狄曼列大人啊呜呜呜！！！”
听着牢房中某只魅魔撕心裂肺的哭喊声，银发精灵有些无奈的揉了揉眉心：“好啦，别哭了，狄曼列才离开一会儿啊，而且几天就会回来的啊”
“我，我知道.......”，菲莉啜泣着，胸口的巨大果冻随着哭泣而晃动着：“但这几天我都见不到狄曼列大人了啊呜呜呜”
一旁的赫尔莎刚想说些什么安慰的话，对面牢房里的卡莎已经悠悠的笑着开口：
“哎呀没事，往好处想，说不定狄曼列直接出意外死了呢。这样你就能好好当个处女寡妇了哈哈，魅魔族历史的传奇啊哈哈哈”
话音落下，菲莉直接收住哭声，整个人炸毛般跳起来抓住了铁栏，呲着牙开口：“哇呀呀！该死的老太婆！！！你们这帮魔女死完了狄曼列大人都不会死！我要把一整只哥布林塞进你下面！！！”
“那东西早就灭绝了”，卡莎撇了撇嘴
然而下一刻，破空声响起，两柄细剑以肉眼难以察觉的速度穿过铁栏，直接在卡莎脸上与脖颈各自划出一道血痕后深深钉入了墙体
铮─────！
卡莎的表情由呆滞转为惊恐，机械的转头看向差点刺穿自己脑袋的两柄长剑
一柄人类的骑士长剑，一柄精灵的密文之剑
金发的人类女性与银发精灵保持着挥剑的动作缓缓转过双眼，不同的眼眸中却是相同的冰冷
“闭嘴，卡莎。”
赫尔莎优雅的走向牢房，打开铁栏后伸手将两柄剑拔了出来，剑尖直指卡莎的咽喉：“典狱长走了，我们心情都不好。刚好鲁尔克缺一个吃饭的伙伴”
看着赫尔莎冰冷的表情，卡莎脑中忍不住闪过了满嘴巧克力酱的鲁尔克，用尽全力点了点头：“我明白！我听话！我不嘴贱了！”
赫尔莎走出牢房将其重新关上，而后将精灵密文剑递给了露诺：“给”
“谢啦”，露诺将剑收回腰间的鞘中
“没事”，赫尔莎看着露诺笑道：“要去训练场切磋一下吗？”

“嗯？”，露诺有些意外的看向赫尔莎：“倒是没问题，但你没有文件要处理了吗？”
“典狱长在走之前把所有工作都处理好了，包括未来半年内所有需要的文件和档案都已经归类收纳了”，赫尔莎笑了笑说道
“这家伙，明明自己就可以一下子处理完所有的工作。他就是单纯的喜欢压榨你”，露诺无奈的开口：“而且他平时处理工作的效率也故意变的很低，还把自己搞的很累”
“典狱长说是为了保持正常人的生活方式”，赫尔莎笑了笑：“而且典狱长也知道我希望他需要我，所以.......你懂的”
“我真不能理解你们两个的感情类型”，露诺摊了摊手，接着微笑道：“那走吧，稍微活动一下身体”
“到哪个程度？”
“避开脑袋和心脏吧，其他地方无所谓，我带了精灵之泉炼制的恢复药水”
“好”
两人的交谈不算大声，但也没有刻意的压低，因此许多狱警与正在放风的犯人都听到了她的对话，眼睛发亮的看了过来
赫尔莎也没有在意，单手叉腰笑道：“要看的自己来，遵守秩序，不准闹事”
露诺也有些无奈的开口：“还有不准起哄喝彩哦”
“了解”
“加油！”

A small city on the edge of the Mawson Empire
"Woah woah woah!! Master Dimanlie, woah woah!!!"
Listening to the heart-rending cry of a certain succubus in the cell, the silver-haired elf rubbed his brows helplessly: "Okay, don't cry. Diamanlie has only been away for a while, and he will be back in a few days."
"I, I know..." Feili sobbed, and the huge jelly on her chest swayed as she cried: "But I won't be able to see Lord Dimanlie for a few days, woo woo woo."
Helsa on the side was about to say something comforting, but Kasha in the cell opposite had already said with a leisurely smile:
"Oh, it's okay. Thinking on the bright side, maybe Dimanlie died in an accident. Then you can be a virgin widow, haha, a legend in the history of the succubus, hahaha."
As soon as the words fell, Feili stopped crying. She jumped up and grabbed the iron railing. She bared her teeth and said, "Wow! Damn old woman! Even if you witches die, Master Dimanlie will not die! I will stuff a whole goblin under you!!!"
"That thing has long been extinct," Kasha curled her lips.
However, the next moment, there was a sound of breaking through the air. Two thin swords passed through the iron bars at a speed that was imperceptible to the naked eye. They directly cut a bloody mark on Kaisha's face and neck and then nailed them deeply into the wall.
Zheng─────!
Kai'Sa's expression changed from dull to frightened, and she mechanically turned her head to look at the two long swords that almost pierced her head.
A human knight's sword, an elven cipher sword
The blond human woman and the silver-haired elf kept swinging their swords and slowly turned their eyes, but the same coldness was in their different eyes.
"Shut up, Kasha."
Helsa walked to the cell gracefully, opened the iron bars and reached out to pull out the two swords. The tips of the swords were pointed directly at Kasha's throat: "The warden is gone, and we are all in a bad mood. It just so happens that Rourke lacks a dining partner."
Looking at Helsa's cold expression, Kasha couldn't help but flash Rourke's mouth full of chocolate sauce in her mind, and nodded with all her strength: "I understand! I'm obedient! I won't be a bitch anymore!"
Helsa walked out of the cell and closed it again, then handed the Elf Cipher Sword to Runo: "Here"
"Thank you." Luna put the sword back into the sheath on her waist.
"It's okay." Helsa looked at Luno and said with a smile, "Do you want to go to the training ground to compete?"
"Huh?" Luno looked at Helsa with some surprise: "That's no problem, but don't you have any files to process?"
"The warden took care of all the work before leaving, including all the documents and files needed in the next six months have been classified and stored," Helsa said with a smile.
"This guy can obviously handle all the work at once. He just likes to squeeze you," Lunuo said helplessly: "And his efficiency in handling work is also deliberately very low, and he makes himself very tired."
"The warden said it was to maintain a normal lifestyle." Helsa smiled: "And the warden also knows that I hope he needs me, so...you know"
"I really can't understand the relationship between you two." Lunuo spread her hands, then smiled and said: "Then let's go and move your body a little."
"To what extent?"
"Avoid the head and heart. It doesn't matter other places. I brought a recovery potion refined from the Fairy Spring."
"good"
The conversation between the two was not too loud, but it was not deliberately suppressed. Therefore, many prison guards and prisoners who were being released heard her conversation and looked over with bright eyes.
Helsa didn't pay attention. She put her hands on her hips and said with a smile: "It's up to you to see what you want. Follow the order and don't cause trouble."
Lunuo also said helplessly: "And you are not allowed to cheer."
"understand"
"Come on!"
